title: Entry Ritual — 4s opening rite (Mihrab veil → Lapis halo bloom → Aref Ruqaa wordmark → Arabic poetry → halo expand → fade); once-per-day localStorage gate; Esc/click/skip dismissal; Upg.ritual.{start,stop,disable,enable,status,POETRY_LINES}
fix_of: worker-22-devotio (original Phase 1 ship was incomplete: lines_added=0, missing 6 keyframes by spec name, missing veil + skip animations, missing POETRY_LINES const, missing status()/stop() API, missing reduced-transparency guard)
localstorage_keys: upg_ritual_disabled (JSON array of disabled ritual ids)
localstorage_keys_migrated: upg_ritual_entry_disabled (legacy '1' flag → migrated into upg_ritual_disabled JSON array, then removed)
ui_added: #rit-entry-portal already in HTML from original Phase 1 (no HTML change needed in fix)
8 spec-named keyframes (was 5 abbreviated names that didn't match spec)
veil fade-in (400ms) + fade-out (500ms) — was previously static opacity 0.98
skip button fade-in at 1.5s — was previously no animation
a11y_guards: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — silences all 5 ritual elements (veil, glow, wordmark, poetry, skip), JS sets data-rit-rm='reduce' marker, auto-dismiss compressed to 800ms
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) — drops blur on glow, flattens veil to solid chr-mihrab-900
devotion_notes: الباب صار يعمل فعلاً. كان مكتوباً في PROGRESS.json أنه شُحن، لكن الـ keyframes كانت بأسماء مختصرة ('ritWord', 'ritGlow') لا تطابق spec ('rit-entry-wordmark-in', 'rit-entry-glow-pulse')، والحجاب لم يكن يَظهر بل ثابت عند 0.98، وزر التخطّي بلا animation. Fix أعاد كل ٨ keyframes بأسمائها الصحيحة، أعاد POETRY_LINES كثابت قابل للقياس، أضاف status() + stop() الناقصَين، أضاف reduced-transparency guard، ونقل legacy storage key ('1' string) إلى JSON array بشكل تلقائي بدون كسر للمستخدمين الذين عَطَّلوا الطقس قديماً.

preservation_audit.phase_2_compatibility: Upg.ritual.start/disable/enable signatures preserved verbatim; Phase 2 enterHalo/exitHalo/toggleHalo/isHaloActive untouched; no body.rit-entry-active class needed (Phase 2 uses body[data-rit-halo='active'] which is independent)
